verdict.final_answer: **Answer:** The review could remain at “Finalizing output…” because TUI shutdown had no timeout: the quit send or the subsequent wait could stall even after reviewer work was done. The fix made the send asynchronous, added bounded waits, and calls Bubble Tea’s `Program.Kill()` as a fallback. That prevents post-run shutdown from waiting indefinitely; local retesting required rebuilding the installed binary with the fix.
